english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for an ordinary walking cane used for support.
Use this for a stick or cane used to help someone walk.
Use 拐杖 specifically for a cane or walking stick used as a walking aid.

examples.english: I need to rely on a cane when I walk.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 lou6 jiu3 kaau3 zyu6 gwaai2 zoeng6

examples.english: Grandpa needs a staff to walk.
examples.jyutping: je4 je2 haang4 lou6 jiu3 jung6 gwaai2 zoeng6

examples.english: Grandpa needs a walking stick to get around.
